rdfs:label: mediator
rdfs:comment: An intermediary that mediates access to or use of the resource — typically for educational or curated content.
notes: From the educational-resources tradition: a teacher who selects and uses a textbook is a `mediator`. Used to express that the resource was filtered or curated by an intermediary before reaching its `urn:solid:audience`. Niche outside library/edu contexts.

examples.title: Course material with a teacher mediator
